lookahead_window_minutes.description: Window (minutes) ahead of now() in which commitments are reminder candidates.

min_reminder_gap_minutes.description: Commitments due sooner than this many minutes are NOT reminded (too late to be useful).

dedupe_window_minutes.description: Recent reminder.dispatched events within this window suppress re-emission for the same commitment_id.

skip_party_tags.description: Parties with any of these tags are skipped (test fixtures etc.).
